sentences.text: Nyx, a 7-year-old female Domestic Shorthair, neuter status not recorded, has a live flag for possible foreign material: the AI photo read of the May 23 vomit noted a possible plastic fragment, unconfirmed, and the photo was not retained.
Vomiting is logged on 4 of the 7 days to Jun 30 and on 23 of 43 logged days over at least 47 days; her first entry of any kind is May 14, so onset is unknown.
She is free-fed all day, start not recorded, with intake not directly observed.
Logging covers 43 of 90 days, 4 of the first 45 and 39 of the last 45, with nothing logged Jul 1 to 2.
